issues.description: Constructor parameter labels for Course differ between the problem statement/template and the solution. The problem statement (and the template) show initialization as Course(name: "My Course", instructor: "My Instructor", ratings: []), and the template defines init(name: String, instructor: String, ratings: [Int]). However, the solution's Course implementation declares init(instructor: String, name: String, ratings: [Int]) (swapped parameter labels), while the solution's Client.swift still constructs the Course using Course(name:..., instructor:..., ratings:...). This creates an internal inconsistency in the solution repository and a cross-artifact mismatch with the problem spec. As written the solution repository is inconsistent and would produce a parameter/label mismatch (compilation error) and confuse students about the expected initializer signature.
issues.suggested_fix: Align the initializer parameter labels across artifacts. Preferably change the solution repository's Course initializer to match the problem/template signature: init(name: String, instructor: String, ratings: [Int]) { self.name = name; self.instructor = instructor; self.ratings = ratings }. Alternatively, update the solution Client construction to use the initializer labels in the Course implementation, but the cleaner fix is to make the solution's initializer match the problem statement and template so students see a consistent API.
